$schema_note: Named quest chains, each in one of three forms: genreIds (JournalGenre row ids concatenated in order; quests keep their journal order inside a genre), questIds (Quest row ids in play order) or startQuest (a Quest row id: the line is that quest and every side quest of its journal section that requires a quest of the line). ongoing: true marks a series the game still adds to, which reads Caught up once every released quest is done. Genres not listed here still become chains on their own when their quests form a single previous-quest line.
